# WellD Schematic — Net Connectivity Reference

**Status (2026-11-28): the schematic is complete and import-ready for PCB layout.** The four sheets (`power`, `mcu`, `sensors`, `interfaces`) are fully wired with stub + label connectivity generated by `kicad_wire_script.py` from the net table that mirrors this document. Two scripts check them:

- `netlist_check.py` re-extracts connectivity from the sheet geometry and diffs it against that table — **447 pins / 81 nets / 8 no-connect markers / 0 mismatches** (`netlist_check_output.txt`; 9 further pins are no-connect *type* — module NC pads, USB-C SBU — and need no marker);
- `footprint_check.py` checks every symbol's pin numbers against its footprint's pad numbers in the KiCad 10.0.0 library and `WellD.pretty` — **163 symbols, every pin has its pad**.

If the sheets and this document ever disagree, treat it as a bug and reconcile.

**Battery architecture (design changes #18 + #19):** **1S Li-ion** — a single generic 18650 in an on-board SMD carrier (BT1), VBAT 3.0–4.2 V, with discrete 1S protection (U13 DW01A + Q6 FS8205A) between cell− and system GND. 1S is a deliberate product decision (the user chose it over 2S on 2026-07-19 for simplicity and parts ecosystem) — do not re-litigate it in later reviews.

**Connectivity style:** *stub + label*, not point-to-point wires — each pin has a short grid-aligned wire stub with a net label (electrically identical for netlisting/ERC):

- **power rails** (`GND`, `+3V3`, `+3V3_ADS`, `VBAT`, `VBAT_RAW`, `VLOOP`, `VUSB`, `VUSB_IN`, `VSOLAR`, `VSOLAR_IN`) → **global labels** (`PWR_FLAG` symbols drive ERC on GND / +3V3 / +3V3_ADS / VUSB / VSOLAR);
- **cross-sheet signals** → **hierarchical labels** + matching sheet pins on `welld.kicad_sch`, joined at the root by stubs + local labels;
- **sheet-local nets** → local labels;
- **unused pins** → explicit `(no_connect)` markers, 8 of them: **DW01A TD**, **CN3791 /DONE** (no spare GPIO), **TP4056 /STDBY** (only /CHRG is monitored), **LM393 OUT2** (second comparator unused, inputs parked), **ESP32 GPIO4** (spare), **ADS1115 AIN3**, **D12 I/O2**, **J3 RF pin**;
- **stacked pins** (the module's GND pads, the USB-C B-row mirrors) share one stub + label.

**Convention:** connections below are given by **pin name** (as printed on the symbol); the pin numbers are in [Symbol pin-number verification](#symbol-pin-number-verification).

## Design changes (current design)

Changes #1–#17 (2026-07-05…07-14) belong to the superseded 2S design and are kept verbatim in [`history/design_history.md`](history/design_history.md).

| # | Change | Reason |
|---|--------|--------|
| 18 | **1S CONVERSION (2026-07-19)** — pack 2S1P → 1S (VBAT 3.0–4.2 V; battery mechanics finalised in #19). **U12 IP2326 boost-charger subsystem deleted** (U12, L3, R_VSET, C_BST2, C_SYS1/C_SYS2, R35) → **TP4056 1 A linear 1S charger** (SOP-8+EPAD; R_PROG 1.2 kΩ → 1 A; RT1 NTC kept on TEMP with new R_NTC 5.6 kΩ top resistor; CE strapped high; /CHRG → existing /CHRG_USB net). **U7 CN3722 controller + external buck stage deleted** (M_SOLAR, D16, C_COM1/2/3, R_COM2, R33/R34 CV divider) → **CN3791 1S MPPT buck charger** (fixed 4.2 V CV at BAT — first drawn as an integrated-switch part, corrected the same day to a controller with an external P-FET stage, see the CN3791 section; D_SOLAR/L_SOLAR/C_VG/RT_SOLAR/R19/R20/R21 kept & repurposed; MPPT set ≈5.0 V for a 6 V panel via R20/R21 = 316k/100k, 1.205 V MPPT reference). **U1 AP63203WU buck deleted** (VIN min 3.8 V fails at 1S empty; L2, C_BST_AP, R_FBH/R_FBL, R11 removed) → **HT7333-A 250 mA LDO** (30 nA-class EN-less part; 3.3 V out, ~90 mV dropout, 4 µA Iq). TVS re-rates: D13 → SMAJ5.0A (VBAT max 4.2 V), D8/D14 → SMAJ10CA (panel ≤6 V nominal). Battery divider R7 330k → **100k** (divide-by-2, firmware ratio 430 → 200). MT3608B VLOOP stage unchanged. GPIO map unchanged (GPIO6 still reads active-low /CHRG_SOLAR; GPIO4 now genuinely spare in hardware). | User decision: 1S chosen deliberately for simplicity/ecosystem after an analysis that slightly favored 2S (≈320 vs ≈300 days runtime). All power-rail ICs reviewed for the 3.0–4.2 V range in the same pass. |
| 19 | **BATTERY CARRIER (2026-07-19)** — the Sinowatt 1S2P pack is dropped for a **single generic 18650 in an on-board SMD carrier (BT1**, replaces J1 XT30**)**. Generic bare cells have no PCM → discrete 1S protection added: **U13 DW01A** supervisor + **Q6 FS8205A** dual N-FET in the cell− → GND path (new nets BATT_N / DW_VCC / DW_OD / DW_OC / DW_CS / DW_D; R_DW1 100 Ω + C_DW 100 nF VCC filter, R_CS_DW 1 kΩ on CS — the exact TP4056-module reference topology). D5 reverse-polarity P-FET stays (reverse *insertion* is now a real user risk); D13 SMAJ5.0A stays on VBAT_RAW. RT1/RT_SOLAR thermal coupling target is now the carrier/cell. Capacity ≈3–3.4 Ah (single cell, was ≈6.7 Ah 2P). | Pinouts drawn from the ubiquitous community maps — **verified against the DW01A-G and FS8205A datasheets 2026-07-19 (the FS8205A map was corrected then)**. |
| 20 | **4–20 mA ADC input hardening (2026-11-27)** — R3/R5 series limiters **100 Ω → 1 kΩ**, C3/C5 **1 µF → 100 nF**, C4/C6 (10 µF bulk) **DNP** — schematic value `10uF DNF` + DNP flag (footprints kept — do not fit: τ = (R2 + R3)·(C3 + C4) ≈ 11 ms reads the level 10–40 % low at the default 10 ms VLOOP warm-up; a fitted C4 would need `CONFIG_WELLD_VLOOP_SETTLE_MS` ≥ ≈110 ms). Values only; no net change (netlist re-verified, 0 mismatches). | With 100 Ω, a shorted transducer or cable (SIG clamped by D9 at ≈7–8 V while VLOOP is on) pushed ≈40 mA through R3 into the D1 clamp diode and on into +3V3, which the HT7333 LDO cannot sink — the rail and the ESP32/ADS1115 would be back-driven for every 10–20 ms loop read. 1 kΩ cuts that to ≈3.5 mA, below the awake rail load. The shunt node is a current source into R2, so C3 sees R2 + R3: the new filter is τ = 1.1 kΩ × 100 nF = 110 µs (fc ≈ 1.45 kHz), settling to 0.01 % in ≈1 ms. The old one was (100 + 100) Ω × 11 µF = 2.2 ms (fc ≈ 72 Hz) and needed ≈20 ms — up to ≈1 % low at a 10 ms read. *(Corrected after the 2026-11-27 senior review: the first version of this note left out R2 and C4.)* C34 (10 nF across R2) adds only ≈1 µs. Accuracy cost: (R2 + R3) vs the ADS1115 input impedance (≈6 MΩ) ≈ 0.02 % gain — below the 0.1 % shunt. |
| 21 | **Loop current limiters + VLOOP 12 → 16 V (2026-11-27, user decision)** — per channel a two-transistor limiter between VLOOP and LOOP+: R52/R54 22 Ω sense, Q8/Q10 **BCP53-16 (SOT-223: 1=B, 2=C, 3=E, 4=C tab — confirmed for Nexperia and onsemi and in KiCad's BCP53 symbol; check the chosen vendor's datasheet at order time)** pass, Q9/Q11 MMBT3906 clamp, R53/R55 15 kΩ base drive; D17/D19 SS34 steer LOOP+ surges into VLOOP/D11 (D17 cathode on VLOOP, D19 on VLOOP_CH2 after SJ2 — so an open SJ2 still isolates J5); D18/D20 SMAJ18A clamp each LOOP+ terminal. New nets LIM_E_CH1/2, LIM_B_CH1/2, LOOP_PWR_CH1/2; J4.1/J5.1 move off VLOOP/VLOOP_CH2 onto LOOP_PWR_CH1/2. VLOOP raised to 15.88 V (R24 100 k → 75 k); D11 SMAJ13A → **SMAJ18A** (VWM must cover 16.7 V). Netlist re-verified: 421 pins / 81 nets / 0 mismatches. Limiter simulated in ngspice (`hardware/pcb/sim/loop_limiter.cir`). | A shorted transducer cable connected VLOOP straight to GND or to the shunt node: the MT3608B ran into its switch current limit, the cell supplied ≈3–4 A and the DW01A over-current trip cut the whole device off until a charger reconnected (with solar: back each morning, tripped again at the first reading). The limiter caps each channel at ≈0.6–0.77 V / 22 Ω ≈ 27–35 mA over −20…+85 °C (simulated: ≈32 mA at 25 °C) (above full scale and NAMUR 21–23 mA alarms), so a short is just reported (> 21 mA) and the boost draws ≤ ≈0.45 A even with both channels shorted. It costs ≈0.5 V at 20 mA, which 12 V could not afford (a transducer got only ≈9.4 V at 20 mA at VLOOP −5 %): at 16 V it gets ≈12.6 V (100 Ω shunt, VLOOP −5 %): 9–36 V types with margin; 12 V-minimum types only with ≤ ≈30 Ω of loop cable, and none at the 130 Ω maximum shunt. **Electrical gate:** (1) MT3608B FB divider recomputed (0.6 V × (1 + 1910/75) = 15.88 V), limiter base drive R53/R55 present; (2) nets documented below; (3) ratings at VLOOP max 16.7 V (≥ 20 % margin): C20/C22 25 V ✓ (20.0 V), D15/D17/D19 SS34 40 V ✓, Q8/Q10 VCEO 80 V ✓, Q9/Q11 VCEO 40 V ✓, R53/R55 0402 50 V ✓, D11/D18/D20 VWM 18 V ≥ 16.7 V ✓; L1 peak ≈0.48 A at 3.2 V in with both channels at 20 mA, ≈0.7 A with both channels in current limit and ≈0.8 A with −20 % L and 1.0 MHz — the (still unresolved, fab checklist) L1 part must have **Isat ≥ 1 A**; C_BST sits on the SW node, which now swings to ≈17 V — **marked DNF** (U8 pin 6 is NC, confirmed; its LCSC C14663 was also an 0603 part on an 0402 footprint); (4) n/a; (5) n/a. Surges (senior-review ngspice, ±1–2 kV / 42 Ω): positive shared by D18/D20 and D11, LOOP+ peaks 27–33 V, PNP E–B reverse ≤ ≈1.1 V (V_EBO 5 V); negative forward-clamped by D18/D20 at −2.9…−4.6 V. **Pass-transistor package corrected after review**: the first draw used an SOT-89 BCX53 with 1=B, whose pinout is vendor-dependent (Nexperia's SOT-89 BCX53 is 1=E, 2=C, 3=B — the board would never have powered a transducer); the BCP5x SOT-223 order is the common one (Nexperia and onsemi confirmed). Surge figures assume **SJ2 bridged**: with SJ2 open D20 takes a J5 surge alone (≈2 kW at 2 kV, beyond an SMAJ), so leave J5 LOOP+ unconnected when SJ2 is open. |
| 22 | **Pre-layout data pass (2026-11-28)** — no net or value change. U6: custom ESP32-C6-MINI-1U symbol replaced by Espressif's official `ESP32-C6-MINI-1/U` (copied into `welld.kicad_sym` as `ESP32-C6-MINI-1U`; footprint vendored as `WellD:ESP32-C6-MINI-1U`); mcu sheet wiring regenerated. J13: B-row pads wired (B6/B7 data, A9/B4/B9 VBUS, A12/B1/B12 GND, shell SH → GND) as hidden pins stacked on the A-row pins; SBU A8/B8 are no-connect pins. Q2/Q4/Q7: `welld:AO3400A` (G=1, S=2, D=3). U1 HT7333-A: SOT-89-3 (GND=1, VIN=2 = tab, VOUT=3). Footprints fixed to names that exist in KiCad 10 (L_SOLAR `L_Bourns_SRN6045TA`, U12 `SOIC-8-1EP_..._EP2.41x3.3mm`); J4–J7/J12 → Phoenix MC 1,5 G headers; SW1/SW2 → C&K KSC6xxJ; SJ2–SJ5 → bridged variants; GDT1/GDT2 → drawn `WellD:GDT_Littelfuse_GTCS23`. LCSC numbers re-verified against LCSC's catalogue. Machine checks: `netlist_check.py` 447 pins / 81 nets / 0 mismatches; `footprint_check.py` 163 symbols, every pin has its pad. **Electrical gate** (inline): no net or value changed, so companion passives, ratings, charger setpoints and pull-ups carry over from #21; the re-mapped pins were checked separately — every U6 GPIO net against the firmware's Kconfig GPIO defaults (8/8 match) and U1 VIN/VOUT against the HT73xx-A SOT-89 pin table. | The custom U6 symbol's pin numbers did not match the module's pads (3V3 would have landed on a GND pad); with only the A-row USB-C pads wired, USB data worked in one plug orientation only; `Device:Q_NMOS` numbers its pins D/G/S, which match no SOT-23 pad; LCSC only stocks the genuine Holtek HT7333-A in SOT-89; two footprint names did not exist; several LCSC fields pointed at unrelated parts (pin headers, a 10 kV diode). |

## Net Inventory

| Net name | Voltage | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| GND | 0V | Ground plane |
| +3V3 | 3.3V | Main logic rail (U1 HT7333-A LDO output) |
| VBAT | 3.0–4.2V | Battery rail after the D5 reverse-polarity switch (single 18650 cell) |
| VBAT_RAW | 3.0–4.2V | Cell positive before D5 (BT1 +, D13, D5 drain, R_DW1 feed) |
| BATT_N | ≈0V | Cell negative (BT1 −) — **not** system GND: joined to GND through the Q6 protection FETs |
| DW_VCC | 3.0–4.2V | DW01A supply (R_DW1/C_DW filtered from cell+) |
| DW_OD / DW_OC | gate drive | DW01A discharge/charge FET gate outputs → Q6 G1/G2 |
| DW_CS | ≈0V | DW01A current-sense input (R_CS_DW to system GND) |
| DW_D | ≈0V | Q6 common-drain node (D1+D2 tied) |
| VUSB | 5V | USB-C VBUS after F2 polyfuse |
| VUSB_IN | 5V | USB-C VBUS raw (J13 VBUS pins, before F2) |
| VSOLAR | ≤10V (Voc) | Solar input after D6 diode = CN3791 VCC node (6 V-nominal panel) |
| VSOLAR_IN | ≤10V (Voc) | Solar panel raw (J12 terminal, before D6) |
| VLOOP | 16V ±5% (15.88 V nominal) | Boost output (MT3608B + D15), loop power — feeds the per-channel limiters (#21); 12 V until 2026-11-27 |
| VLOOP_SW | switching | MT3608B SW node (L1 / D15 anode / C_BST) |
| VLOOP_L | 3.0–4.2V gated | Q3 drain → L1 input (boost disconnect branch) |
| +3V3_ADS | 3.3V filtered | ADS1115 VDD (after FB1 ferrite bead) |
| MT_FB | 0.6V | MT3608B feedback divider mid-point (R23/R24) |
| MPPT_REF | 1.205V | CN3791 MPPT (6) divider mid-point (R20/R21 = 316k/100k → V_MP ≈ 5.0 V; ✅ 1.205 V ref datasheet-verified) |
| SOLAR_SW | switching | M_SOLAR drain → D16 anode (external P-FET buck — the CN3791 is a **controller**, verified 2026-07-19) |
| SOLAR_FW | switching | Freewheel node: D16 cathode / D_SOLAR cathode / L_SOLAR in |
| CN_DRV | gate drive | U7 DRV (10) → M_SOLAR gate; R_DRV 300 k gate–source pull-off |
| CN_CS | 3.0–4.2V | Current-sense node: L_SOLAR out / R19 (R_CS 0.1 Ω) / U7 CSP (8); ✅ I_CH = 120 mV/R_CS verified → 1.2 A |
| CN_VG | analog | U7 VG (1) gate-driver regulator — C_VG 100 nF to **VCC** (✅ datasheet-verified) |
| CN_COM / COM_RC | analog | U7 COM (5) loop compensation: 220 nF + 120 Ω series to GND (✅ datasheet values) |
| NTC_T | 0–0.5·VSOLAR | Cold-cutoff temperature node: R_NT1 (30 k) / RT_SOLAR (10 k B3950) divider → U14 IN1+ (ratiometric — threshold independent of panel voltage) |
| NTC_REF | 0.5·VSOLAR | Cold-cutoff reference node: R_NT2/R_NT3 (100 k/100 k) → U14 IN1− (also parks unused IN2−) |
| NTC_OUT | 0/VSOLAR | U14 OUT1 (o.c., R_PU 100 k) → Q7 gate; R_HYS 330 k back to NTC_T gives ≈2 °C hysteresis |
| ADS_DRDY | signal | ADS1115 ALERT/RDY open-drain → GPIO22 (R_DRDY pull-up); moved off GPIO12 = USB D− |
| I2C_SDA | signal | I²C SDA → **GPIO18** (R9 pull-up) — moved off GPIO10 (not bonded on MINI-1, 2026-07-21) |
| I2C_SCL | signal | I²C SCL → **GPIO19** (R10 pull-up) — moved off GPIO11 |
| ADC_CH0 | 0–2.0V | ADS1115 AIN0 (CH1 4-20mA after protection chain) |
| ADC_CH1 | 0–2.0V | ADS1115 AIN1 (CH2 4-20mA after protection chain) |
| ADC_CH2 | 0–2.1V | ADS1115 AIN2 (battery divider mid-point, ÷2) — firmware must use the ±4.096 V PGA range |
| VBAT_SW | 3.0–4.2V gated | Q5 drain → R7 top (battery divider, gated) |
| Q3_GATE / Q5_GATE | analog | P-FET gate nodes (level-shifted from GPIO5 / GPIO15) |
| 1WIRE | signal | DS18B20 data → GPIO7 (R6 pull-up) |
| LOOP_TERM_CH1/2 | signal | 4-20mA SIG inputs from J4/J5 |
| LOOP_PWR_CH1/2 | ≈ VLOOP − 0.5 V at 20 mA | Current-limited LOOP+ (J4.1 / J5.1) — limiter output (#21) |
| LIM_E_CH1/2, LIM_B_CH1/2 | analog | Limiter sense node (R52/R54 low side = pass emitter = clamp base) and pass-transistor base node (#21) |
| SHUNT_IN_1/2, SHUNT_OUT_1/2 | analog | Shunt chain intermediate nets (see ADC_CH0/1) |
| /CHRG_SOLAR | signal | CN3791 /CHRG (open-drain, active-low) → GPIO6, R25 pull-up |
| /CHRG_USB | signal | TP4056 /CHRG (open-drain, LOW = charging) → R38 pull-up → TP15 only |
| ~~USB_CE~~ | — | **DELETED 2026-07-05** — and finally moot 2026-07-19: TP4056 CE is strapped high in hardware; **GPIO4 is spare, no schematic connection** |
| USB_PROG | analog | TP4056 PROG pin → R_PROG 1.2 kΩ → GND (I_CH = 1200 V·Ω⁻¹… per DS: 1 A at 1.2 kΩ) |
| USB_NTC | analog | TP4056 TEMP pin: R_NTC 5.6k from VUSB, RT1 10k NTC to GND (✅ computed window **+8…+44 °C**) |
| BATT_DIV_EN | signal | GPIO15 → Q2 gate (HIGH enables battery divider via Q5) |
| VBOOST_EN | signal | GPIO5 → MT3608B EN + Q4 gate (HIGH = 16 V loop on); R27 pull-down |
| GPIO14_LED | signal | Status LED (GPIO14 → R14 → D4 → SJ3 → GND) |
| FACTORY_RESET | signal | GPIO23 → TP13 pad (hold LOW at boot = NVS + Zigbee network erase, re-pair with permit-join); moved off GPIO13 = USB D+ |
| UART_TX / UART_RX | signal | Debug UART GPIO16/GPIO17 → SJ4/SJ5 → J10 |
| EN | signal | ESP32-C6 EN (R15 pull-up, C36, SW1, J10) |
| BOOT | signal | ESP32-C6 GPIO9 (R12 pull-up, SW2, J10) |

The TP4056 (1S conversion) has its CE (pin 8) strapped high to VUSB in hardware — it charges whenever VBUS is present. **GPIO4 is spare with no schematic connection**; the firmware's charger-CE drive was removed with the 1S conversion (no charger GPIO exists).

### Battery carrier + 1S protection (BT1 / U13 DW01A / Q6 FS8205A — new 2026-07-19)

A generic bare 18650 has no PCM, so the standard TP4056-ecosystem protection pair sits in the cell− path: `BT1 − (BATT_N) → Q6 S1 → [FET1] → DW_D (D1+D2 tied) → [FET2] → Q6 S2 → GND (P−)`. The DW01A is referenced to the cell (GND pin on BATT_N) and cuts the appropriate FET on over-discharge (≈2.40 V), over-charge (≈4.30 V), or over-current (CS threshold across the FET pair).

| Component | Pin | Connection |
|-----------|-----|------------|
| BT1 | + (1) / − (2) | VBAT_RAW / BATT_N. 18650 carrier, footprint **`Battery:BatteryHolder_Keystone_1042_1x18650`** (KiCad standard, ✅ confirmed 2026-07-21 — no custom draw) |
| U13 DW01A | OD (1) | DW_OD → Q6 G1 (discharge-blocking FET, source at cell−) |
| U13 DW01A | CS (2) | DW_CS → R_CS_DW (1 kΩ) → GND — senses P− relative to cell− across the FET pair |
| U13 DW01A | OC (3) | DW_OC → Q6 G2 (charge-blocking FET, source at P−) |
| U13 DW01A | TD (4) | **NC** (test/delay pin — floats in every reference design) |
| U13 DW01A | VCC (5) | DW_VCC ← R_DW1 (100 Ω) ← VBAT_RAW; C_DW (100 nF) to BATT_N |
| U13 DW01A | GND (6) | BATT_N (cell−) |
| Q6 FS8205A | S1 (2,3) / G1 (4) | BATT_N / DW_OD |
| Q6 FS8205A | S2 (6,7) / G2 (5) | GND / DW_OC |
| Q6 FS8205A | D (1,8) | DW_D — drains are **internally common** (✅ verified); both pins tied on the PCB too |

✅ **Verified 2026-07-19 (blocker #11a/b)**: DW01A pin map (OD=1, CS=2, OC=3, TD=4, VCC=5, GND=6) and thresholds (over-discharge 2.40 V / release 3.0 V; over-charge 4.30 V / release 4.1 V) confirmed against datasheet sources; the 100 Ω/100 nF/1 kΩ network is the documented typical application. FS8205A pin map **corrected** to the real TSSOP-8 layout (D=1&8 internally common, S1=2&3, G1=4, G2=5, S2=6&7; 20 V, ±12 V VGS, ~6 A). The chargers and load all sit on the **system** side (VBAT/GND), so protection trips isolate the cell, exactly as on the pack PCM this replaces.

### CN3791 — pin map and power stage (SSOP-10; ✅ DATASHEET-VERIFIED + CORRECTED 2026-07-19)

**Correction (datasheet verification pass, 2026-07-19):** the CN3791 is **not** an integrated-switch part — like its CN3722 sibling it is a **controller** whose DRV pin drives an **external P-FET buck stage** (DS: "gate driver … drives the external pass transistor", 40 ns into 2000 pF, gate clamp 8 V). The external stage is restored: `VSOLAR → M_SOLAR (SI2319CDS) → SOLAR_SW → D16 (series Schottky, blocks night back-feed through the FET body diode into the MPPT divider and VCC) → SOLAR_FW → L_SOLAR (22 µH) → CN_CS → R19 (R_CS 0.1 Ω) → VBAT`, `D_SOLAR` freewheeling GND → SOLAR_FW. What it does NOT need vs the CN3722: no CV divider (fixed 4.2 V ±1 % at BAT) and one COM pin instead of three. **It also has NO TEMP pin — see the temperature-cutoff warning below.** Pin map verified against the Consonance datasheet extractions and the Soldered Electronics open-hardware KiCad design:

| U7 pin | Name | Connection |
|--------|------|------------|
| 1 | VG | C_VG (100 nF) → **VCC** (gate-driver regulator; VG ≈ VCC − 6.3 V, clamped (VCC−VG) ≤ 8 V) |
| 2 | GND | GND |
| 3 | /CHRG | /CHRG_SOLAR net (open-drain, LOW = charging) — R25 pull-up, GPIO6, D7/R22, TP14 |
| 4 | /DONE | Open-drain, LOW = charge done. **NC** (no spare GPIO); pad available for future TP |
| 5 | COM | Loop compensation: C_COM 220 nF in series with R_COM 120 Ω → GND (datasheet-required values) |
| 6 | MPPT | MPPT_REF divider mid (R20/R21 = 316k/100k → V_MP = 1.205 × (1+316/100) ≈ 5.01 V; 1.205 V ref ✅) |
| 7 | BAT | VBAT (pack side of R19) — current-sense negative **and 4.2 V CV point**. Sleep current BAT+CSP ≈ **9 µA at 4.2 V** (power budget) |
| 8 | CSP | CN_CS node (inductor side of R19) — current-sense positive |
| 9 | VCC | VSOLAR (C17/C21/D8 at pin); 4.5–28 V operating, 30 V abs max |
| 10 | DRV | CN_DRV → M_SOLAR gate; R_DRV 300 k gate–source pull-off (per the Soldered reference design) |

**Charge current** (✅ verified): I_CH = 120 mV / R_CS = 120 mV / 0.1 Ω = **1.2 A**. R19: 0.1 Ω 1 % 1206 (P ≈ 0.14 W). Switching frequency 300 kHz.

> The CN3791 has no TEMP/NTC pin, so solar charging gets its cold-charge protection from the discrete LM393 cutoff in the next section (added 2026-07-19 — it resolved old blocker #10f).

### Solar cold-charge cutoff (U14 LM393 — NEW 2026-07-19, resolves #10f)

The CN3791 has no TEMP pin, so cold-charge protection is discrete. **Powered from VSOLAR**: at night the whole circuit is dead (D6 blocks the battery; D16 blocks the FET-body back-feed), so it costs **zero** sleep current; in daylight its ~1 mA is free panel power. Both dividers are ratiometric to VSOLAR, so the temperature threshold is independent of panel voltage (valid for VSOLAR ≳ 3 V — below the CN3791's own 4.5 V UVLO anyway).

Operation: cold → RT_SOLAR resistance rises → NTC_T > NTC_REF → OUT1 releases (pulled up by R_PU) → **Q7 clamps the MPPT pin low** → the CN3791 sees a "collapsed panel" and backs the duty cycle to zero — charging stops. Warm → OUT1 sinks low → Q7 off → normal MPPT operation. R_HYS gives ≈2 °C of hysteresis (trip ≈ +2 °C falling, release ≈ +4 °C).

| Component | Pin | Connection |
|-----------|-----|------------|
| U14 LM393 | VCC (8) / GND (4) | VSOLAR / GND; C_NTC 100 nF at VCC. Industry-universal dual-comparator pinout (OUT1=1, IN1−=2, IN1+=3, GND=4, IN2+=5, IN2−=6, OUT2=7, VCC=8) — confirm on the vendor DS at order time |
| U14 | IN1+ (3) | NTC_T: VSOLAR → R_NT1 (30 k) → node → RT_SOLAR (10 k B3950, thermally coupled to the **cell**) → GND. 30 k ≈ NTC at +2 °C |
| U14 | IN1− (2) | NTC_REF: VSOLAR → R_NT2 (100 k) → node → R_NT3 (100 k) → GND (0.5·VSOLAR) |
| U14 | OUT1 (1) | NTC_OUT: R_PU (100 k → VSOLAR) pull-up; → Q7 gate; R_HYS (330 k) positive feedback to NTC_T |
| U14 | IN2+ (5) / IN2− (6) / OUT2 (7) | Unused half: IN2+ → GND, IN2− → NTC_REF (defined state, in common-mode range), OUT2 **NC** |
| Q7 AO3400A | G / D / S | NTC_OUT / **MPPT_REF** / GND — clamps the MPPT divider mid-point below the 1.205 V reference when cold. Note: Vgs ≈ VSOLAR (≤10 V worst case) vs the AO3400A ±12 V abs max — acceptable; revisit if a >6 V-nominal panel is ever specified |

Design notes: the clamp is small-signal (through R20 316 k from VSOLAR) — no power-path contention with the DRV driver; the comparator common-mode (≈0.5·VSOLAR) stays inside the LM393 range (V+ − 1.5 V) for VSOLAR ≥ 3 V. Bench-verify trip/release and zero charge current while clamped (fab checklist row 6).

### Loop current limiters (design change #21 — one per channel)

`VLOOP → R52 22 Ω → LIM_E_CH1 → Q8 (PNP pass) → LOOP_PWR_CH1 = J4 LOOP+` — Q9 (PNP clamp) senses the R52 drop: once I × 22 Ω reaches its V_BE (≈0.6–0.77 V over −20…+85 °C) it pulls Q8's base up and holds the current at ≈27–35 mA. CH2 is identical from `VLOOP_CH2` (after SJ2) to J5 LOOP+.

| Component | Pin | Net | Note |
|-----------|-----|-----|------|
| R52 / R54 (22 Ω 0603) | 1 / 2 | VLOOP (CH2: VLOOP_CH2) / LIM_E_CH1 (LIM_E_CH2) | Sense resistor |
| Q8 / Q10 BCP53-16 (SOT-223: 1=B, 2=C, 3=E, 4=C tab) | E (3) | LIM_E_CH1 / LIM_E_CH2 | Pass transistor emitter |
| Q8 / Q10 | B (1) | LIM_B_CH1 / LIM_B_CH2 | Pulled low by R53/R55 (≈1 mA drive) |
| Q8 / Q10 | C (2) | LOOP_PWR_CH1 / LOOP_PWR_CH2 | To J4.1 / J5.1 |
| Q9 / Q11 MMBT3906 (SOT-23: 1=B, 2=E, 3=C) | E (2) | VLOOP / VLOOP_CH2 | Clamp emitter at the top of the sense resistor |
| Q9 / Q11 | B (1) | LIM_E_CH1 / LIM_E_CH2 | Clamp base at the bottom of the sense resistor |
| Q9 / Q11 | C (3) | LIM_B_CH1 / LIM_B_CH2 | Steals the pass base drive when limiting |
| R53 / R55 (15 kΩ 0402) | 1 / 2 | LIM_B_CH1 (LIM_B_CH2) / GND | Base drive |
| D17 / D19 SS34 | K (1) | VLOOP / VLOOP_CH2 | Surge steering: LOOP+ above the limiter input bypasses the limiter into D11/C20 — PNP E–B reverse stays ≤ ≈1 V. D19 sits after SJ2 so an open SJ2 does not tie J5 to VLOOP |
| D17 / D19 | A (2) | LOOP_PWR_CH1 / LOOP_PWR_CH2 | |
| D18 / D20 SMAJ18A | K (1) | LOOP_PWR_CH1 / LOOP_PWR_CH2 | Terminal clamp: negatives forward-clamped at ≈−1 V, positives at ≥ 20 V |
| D18 / D20 | A (2) | GND | |

> In a dead short the pass transistor dissipates up to ≈0.4–0.56 W (simulated, −20…+85 °C) for as long as VLOOP is on (10–15 ms by default; up to `CONFIG_WELLD_VLOOP_SETTLE_MS` if raised — the firmware then checks for a short after 10 ms). SOT-223 with ≥ 1 cm² of collector copper handles that. A LOOP+→SIG short reads 27–35 mA (2.7–3.5 V on the shunt), which the firmware reports as a short-circuit; a LOOP+→GND short bypasses the shunt and reads as an open loop.

### ADC_CH2 (battery divider — corrected high-side gating)

Path: `VBAT → Q5 (P-FET) → R7 (100k) → mid (ADC_CH2) → R8 (100k) → GND` (÷2 for 1S, changed 2026-07-19 — was 330k/100k ÷4.3 for 2S)

| Component | Pin | Note |
|-----------|-----|------|
| Q5 AO3407 | S | VBAT |
| Q5 AO3407 | D | VBAT_SW → R7 pin 1 |
| Q5 AO3407 | G | Q5_GATE: R16 (100k) to VBAT; Q2 drain pulls low to enable |
| Q2 AO3400A | D | Q5_GATE |
| Q2 AO3400A | G | BATT_DIV_EN (GPIO15), R26 (4.7k) pull-down |
| Q2 AO3400A | S | GND |
| R7 | pin 2 | ADC_CH2 (mid) |
| R8 | pin 1 / pin 2 | mid / GND |
| C8 (**1 nF**) | pins 1–2 | across R8 — τ ≈ 50 µs (R7‖R8 = 50 k), settles well inside the 1 ms firmware enable window |
| U9 ADS1115 | AIN2 | 4.2 V × 100/200 = **2.1 V max — exceeds the ±2.048 V PGA range**; ✅ firmware reads AIN2 on the **±4.096 V PGA** (1S firmware-handoff item, done together with `CONFIG_WELLD_BATT_DIVIDER_RATIO` 430 → 200) |

> With Q5 off, the divider is fully dead: AIN2 rests at 0 V through R8 and there is no sneak path into the ADS1115 ESD diodes (the old low-side switch leaked ~14 µA into AIN2 during sleep).

### J7 spare sensor / J9 GPIO header

- J7: pin 1 = +3V3, pin 2 = GPIO3 (spare ADC), pin 3 = GND.
- J9 (8-pin, DNF): +3V3, GND, GPIO0, GPIO1, GPIO2, GPIO3, GPIO20, GPIO21.

### RF

`U6 U.FL port → W1 pigtail (hand-fitted, not in the schematic) → J3 SMA`. J3's RF pin is a no-connect and its ground ring goes to GND. **The RF path is an open decision before layout** — as drawn, the pigtail's SMA plug would occupy J3, leaving no port for the antenna. See "Decisions needed before layout" in [`README.md`](README.md).

## Power-On Sequence Reference

1. Cell inserted into BT1 → DW01A powers from cell+ (R_DW1/C_DW) and enables both Q6 FETs (BATT_N ≈ GND) → VBAT_RAW → D5 body diode conducts, then channel enhances (gate at GND via R31) → VBAT. A reversed cell is blocked by D5; a deeply-discharged cell is isolated by the DW01A until a charger raises it.
2. U1 HT7333-A LDO regulates (no EN pin — always on) → +3V3 → C36/R15 delay → ESP32 boots.
3. Boost idles: R27 holds MT3608B EN + Q4 low. Both chargers are autonomous — CN3791 charges whenever panel power is present, TP4056 whenever VBUS is present (CE strapped high; no enable GPIOs).
4. Firmware: GPIO5 HIGH → U8 EN + Q4 → Q3 closes → VLOOP = 16 V (`CONFIG_WELLD_VLOOP_SETTLE_MS`, default 10 ms, for C20/C22 charge through Q3 and the transducer start-up; the rail passes the old 12 V level sooner than it used to reach it) → each LOOP+ fed through its 27–35 mA limiter → loop read → GPIO5 LOW.
5. Firmware: GPIO15 HIGH → Q2 → Q5 closes → divider live (settles < 1 ms with C8 = 1 nF) → AIN2 read → GPIO15 LOW.
6. Deep sleep: all control GPIOs driven LOW then isolated; R27/R26/R31 define every switch state passively. No DC path from VBAT except U1 (4 µA Iq) and IC quiescents.
